visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot of a clear glass containing ice cubes and dark coffee. A beige ladle pours a thick, velvety white cream onto the surface of the coffee, followed by a hand with light-colored manicured nails stirring the mixture with a spoon. (2) The scene transitions to a white kitchen countertop where several coffee boxes labeled 'CAFE!N' and various dairy products are displayed. A hand points toward the ingredients. (3) Sequence of individual shots showing the specific brands of ingredients used: Cascade Dairy cream cheese, Oldenburger cooking cream, Nestle condensed milk, and a small carton of whole milk. (4) In a stainless steel mixing bowl, a dollop of white cream cheese is added. A ceramic jar labeled 'SALT' is shown being held, representing the sea salt addition. (5) The hand squeezes condensed milk from a tube into the bowl, then pours the heavy cream. The lighting is bright and even throughout the indoor kitchen setting. (6) A stand mixer whisk begins rotating at high speed, whipping the white mixture into a smooth, semi-solid texture. The camera zooms in to capture the thickening process. (7) More milk is added from a carton into the whipped mixture, and the whisk continues to blend everything together. (8) A glass is filled with water from a stainless steel tap, ice is added, and then a black coffee capsule is opened and poured in. (9) The prepared sea salt cream is poured generously onto the iced coffee. A pink 'CAFE!N' sachet is also shown. (10) The remaining cream is poured from the mixing bowl into a clear plastic container for storage.

It appeals to viewers interested in 'cafe-at-home' aesthetics and DIY coffee recipes.
